name: MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.CAR.RepresentativeShellFamily
title: A fixed representative family of CAR shell data

content.display_title: A fixed representative family of CAR shell data
content.one_sentence_role: One family records a transporting automorphism and exact shell links for each selected pure-state class, with an explicitly fixed root component.
content.natural_language_statement: Let $A$ be the completed CAR algebra, the norm completion of the matrix stages $A_n=M_{2^n}(\mathbb C)$ under $a\mapsto a\otimes I_2$, with the fixed coordinate reindexing. Write $\iota_n:A_n\to A$ for the canonical inclusion, $\omega(\iota_n(a))=a_{00}$ for the root state, $f_n=\iota_n(E_{00})$ for its decreasing root projections, and $p_n=f_n-f_{n+1}$ for the difference shells. Each $p_n$ is a self-adjoint projection. Let $I$ be the set of unitary-equivalence classes of pure-state Gelfand–Naimark–Segal (GNS) representations of $A$. Choose a representative pure state $\varphi_j$ for each $j\in I$, with the distinguished class $o=[\omega]$ represented by $\varphi_o=\omega$. A representative shell family assigns to each $j\in I$ an automorphism $\alpha_j$ and links $w_{j,n}\in A$ with $\varphi_j(\alpha_j(a))=\omega(a)$ for every $a$, $w_{j,n}^*w_{j,n}=\alpha_j(p_n)$, and $w_{j,n}w_{j,n}^*=p_n$ for every $n$. At the distinguished class it further requires $\alpha_o=\mathrm{id}_A$ and $w_{o,n}=p_n$.
content.definition_explanation: The component structure stores $\alpha_j$, the equation $\varphi_j\circ\alpha_j=\omega$, the sequence $(w_{j,n})$, and its initial and final supports. The family structure chooses a component for every class and adds the root equations. They normalize a distinguished component of this chosen family; they do not impose equality between arbitrary choices made in unrelated existence statements.
content.assumptions: The CAR system, root state, and selected representatives are fixed. A family is supplied as data of this structure. There is no restriction that $I$ be countable, and this structure declaration does not itself prove the existence of such a family.
content.conclusion: The fields are the component data for every class and the two root equations. Each component contains one automorphism, its state-transport equation, its link sequence, and both support equations. The root shell $p_n=f_n-f_{n+1}$ is distinguished from the nested flag projection $f_n$.
content.lean_realization_notes: No rank-one, capture, simplicity, compactness, or approximate-innerness conclusion is stored in this structure. A later constructor can use approximate innerness to build the links, but that construction property is not an extra field required of every supplied family.
